newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - August 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - August 19.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on August 19. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Indonesian monetary authorities were expected on Tuesday to announce new measures to further tighten rupiah liquidity, Coordinating Minister for Finance and Economics Saleh Afiff said on Monday following a meeting among monetary authorities including himself, Finance Minister Mar''ie Muhammad, central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono, state secretary Murdiono and two senior economic advisers.

Legislators deliberating the widely-criticised manpower bill claimed they have achieved progress by including a provision that the establishment of workers unions is to be regulated by a separate law.
The price of newsprint in Indonesia has risen from 1,390 rupiah/kg to 1,620 rupiah/kg following the recent dramatic fall in the value of the rupiah.
Jailed East Timorese rebel leader Xanana Gusmao has reportedly said he never asked South African President Nelson Mandela to ask for his release from a Jakarta prison.
